summary: Vasquez voted Yea on H.R. 6090, the Antisemitism Awareness Act, in May 2024, a bill directing the IHRA definition and examples into Title VI education-discrimination enforcement. JStreet PAC issued a Priority endorsement to Vasquez in 2024, adding modest context to the alignment picture.
